# Lucide icons

Selected SVGs from the official `lucide-static` npm package, version 1.60.0, combined into a local SVG sprite. Original path data is unchanged.

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide

Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/lucide-static/-/lucide-static-1.60.0.tgz

License: ISC; full upstream notice is included in `LICENSE`.

`../../icons.js` provides the shared decorative icon helpers. Icon-only controls provide their accessible name on the button. No CDN or runtime package is required.
